# UI Foundations

> uGUI building blocks for strict MVC in Unity 6: `BaseClickController`, an invisible raycast target with an `OnClick()` override that replaces `Button`, and `ViewStateMachine`, which shows one of several mutually exclusive looks with instant or fade transitions. Keeps input and visuals apart. MIT licensed, pre-release (0.x).

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/sgonzalezrozo/unity-ui-foundations/blob/main/README.md): installation, quick start, API, troubleshooting, FAQ
- [Rules for AI coding agents](https://github.com/sgonzalezrozo/unity-ui-foundations/blob/main/Documentation~/agent-rules.md): copy into AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md or Cursor rules
- [Changelog](https://github.com/sgonzalezrozo/unity-ui-foundations/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
